title: Tryouts and Group Chat
author: Zephyrine Oyelaran
blurb: Orsen Ravensworth, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
